2026-10-01.title: God is the Greatest of All
2026-10-01.verse: A psalm of Asaph. God stands in the assembly of El; in the midst of the gods he renders judgment.
2026-10-01.observation: This is one of the most talked-about and controversial songs in the entire Bible. Scholars debate this song continuously. There are those who say this is speaking of a heavenly leadership cabinet where God has delegated authority to heavenly beings. This would be much like how Moses instituted what we call the “Jethro Principle” in the book of Exodus. The goal is to have a leadership structure for serving people. This is not because God cannot do it Himself. It is because He prefers to work through relationships and others. Other scholars argue that it refers to earthly judges and the term “heaven’s court” refers to the people of God and the fact that the Law is holy in its judgment. No matter where you stand on this passage, the bottom line is the same. God presides over it all. He is the King of kings and Lord of lords. There is nothing that even remotely compares to Him.
2026-10-01.application: Think of the great privilege we have of being able to pray and talk to the King of kings any time we want.
2026-10-01.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being so great yet caring so much for us.

2026-10-02.title: Ask God The Hard Questions
2026-10-02.verse: A song, a psalm of Asaph. O God, do not be silent. Do not ignore us. Do not be inactive, O God. For look, your enemies are making a commotion; those who hate you are hostile.
2026-10-02.observation: When we have conflict or difficulty with others, many of us tend to isolate ourselves from them. We cope with the difference of opinion or methodology by removing ourselves from them. Over time the distance grows until the relationship is basically over. If we are not careful, we can do the same with God. When God does not act in a way we think or in a time that we think, we begin to wonder what is going on. Because we are unsure, we begin to isolate from Him and the spiral begins. Instead of doing that, be like the songwriter in today’s chapter. The songwriter asks God very straightforward questions. Don’t allow your misunderstanding of God to cause distance. Be honest and allow God to calm your heart and mind.
2026-10-02.application: Be honest with God in your prayer time today.
2026-10-02.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for allowing us to bring our whole selves into our relationship with You.

2026-10-03.title: The Joy of Trusting the Lord
2026-10-03.verse: How blessed are those who find their strength in you and long to travel the roads that lead to your temple. As they pass through the Baca Valley, he provides a spring for them. The rain even covers it with pools of water.
2026-10-03.observation: When my girls were little, they were very afraid of the dark. When we would have to walk through the dark to get to our car, or to get to a light switch, they would freak out. Instead of keeping them from the dark, I would always take them by the hand as we walked. Along the way, I would continually say, “Daddy is here. It’s okay. Nothing will happen to you. If anything happens, I will take care of it.” I would hear their little voice quiver in response, “Okay daddy. Let’s go.” They would try to be brave, even though they didn’t feel like it. Their confidence was not that there was nothing in the dark. They probably felt certain there was something waiting for them. Their confidence was that their daddy was bigger than any monster. Our trust in God is like that. He doesn’t always keep away the darkness, but He goes with us through it. As we walk, we can be confident that there is no monster in the dark that is bigger than our Heavenly Father.
2026-10-03.application: Trust God in your dark season. He’s bigger than any monster you will face.
2026-10-03.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for walking with us every day.

2026-10-04.title: Keep Listening
2026-10-04.verse: I will listen to what God the Lord says. For he will make peace with his people, his faithful followers. Yet they must not return to their foolish ways.
2026-10-04.observation: When I was younger, my mouth worked faster than my brain. Often, I would hear part of what someone would say and start talking. I was so interested in engaging with a new idea that I did not hear all of what they were saying. It must have been extremely frustrating to talk to me. While I am still not great at it, I have learned that listening carefully is a skill. If we listen more than we talk, we are usually going to hear more than we expected. It’s like that when we read God’s Word. When we read God’s Word daily and approach each passage as though it is the first time, we can be surprised at what we will find. There’s richness in every passage that we have never found. Every day, be sure to come to God’s Word with fresh eyes and watch as He reveals Himself to you in fresh and new ways.
2026-10-04.application: Read God’s Word with fresh eyes every day.
2026-10-04.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always being fresh and new to all who truly seek You.

2026-10-05.title: God is Ready to Forgive
2026-10-05.verse: Certainly, O Lord, you are kind and forgiving, and show great faithfulness to all who cry out to you.
2026-10-05.observation: When someone gets hurt physically or emotionally, most of us tend to isolate ourselves. When we feel wounded, we go into self-protection mode. This is true in relationships. Most people do not react well when they realize they have hurt someone else. Instead of reaching out to make things right, we feel awkward and step away. If left unchecked, this can lead to distance and, eventually, to the loss of relationship. If we are not careful, we can do the same with God. When we sin against the Lord, we should be ready to run back to Him. However, we often isolate ourselves. We create distance because we knew we should have done one thing and, instead, did something else. Would we still do that if we realized how much the Lord loves us? Would we still hide if we realized that the Lord was there when we sinned and that, while the sin is not okay, He is ready to forgive? How much peace we often forfeit from our own souls, because we try to carry the weight of sin alone. Why not give it to God? He is ready to forgive.
2026-10-05.application: Get honest with God today. Tell Him about it all and realize we don’t have to earn His forgiveness. It is freely given.
2026-10-05.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being willing to forgive us no matter how many times we mess up.

2026-10-06.title: We are All Citizens of God’s Kingdom
2026-10-06.verse: The Lord writes in the census book of the nations, “This one was born there.” (Selah) As for the singers, as well as the pipers— all of them sing within your walls.
2026-10-06.observation: This song speaks about a day when all will be part of the great city. In Jewish society, the city was more than a location. It represented the seat of power for the King of the Universe. He had made Jerusalem the capital of His Earthly rule. The Jewish nation was supposed to be His representatives to the world. The song says that no matter where someone has been scattered to, they will one day all be part of the kingdom of God again. We know this was not fulfilled with military conquest but with the death, burial, and resurrection of Jesus Christ. Because of Jesus, all have the opportunity to become part of the kingdom of God. This does not happen automatically. We must turn our hearts toward Jesus, repent of our sin, and declare Jesus as Lord.
2026-10-06.application: Celebrate your part in the Kingdom of God.
2026-10-06.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for inviting us all to be part of Your kingdom.

2026-10-07.title: The God Who Listens
2026-10-07.verse: A song, a psalm written by the Korahites, for the music director, according to the machalath-leannoth style; a well-written song by Heman the Ezrahite. O Lord God who delivers me, by day I cry out and at night I pray before you. Listen to my prayer. Pay attention to my cry for help. For my life is filled with troubles, and I am ready to enter Sheol.
2026-10-07.observation: Have you ever been talking to someone and you could tell they were not really listening? They were just waiting for their turn to talk? Have you ever been that person? I have and it’s embarrassing when you realize you didn’t actually hear what the other person said. We must always remember that is not our God. He is not waiting for us to stop talking so He can move on. How often do we realize that we have the complete attention of the King of the Universe? The One who made everything is listening when we cry out to Him. Many people look for a friend with whom they can be honest. They know that friend cannot do anything about the situation. They just want someone that will hear them complain. God is the best of friends because He not only is willing to listen to us, He can do something about the situation. So, take a moment and talk with the King of the Universe today. He is listening.
2026-10-07.application: Spend time with God today. Talk to Him about whatever is on your heart.
2026-10-07.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always being willing to listen to us.

2026-10-08.title: The Loving Discipline of the Lord
2026-10-08.verse: I will punish their rebellion by beating them with a club, their sin by inflicting them with bruises. But I will not remove my loyal love from him nor be unfaithful to my promise.
2026-10-08.observation: Some people think that a perfectly loving parent is a parent who never disciplines their children. They believe a perfectly loving parent is always giving, always lenient, and never has boundaries. However, anyone who has been a parent for longer than five minutes knows this is not the case. Sometimes a loving parent will discipline their child out of the overflow of their love for their child. For example, if a child really wants to walk off a cliff to see what it feels like to fly, a loving parent will do everything in their power to stop that child from doing so. They will risk hurting their child’s feelings in order to keep them safe. A parent will also establish boundaries and consequences in order to help the child learn how to be safe and how to treat their neighbor with grace. It is out of their love for their child that they will follow through on those proper consequences so lessons can be learned. This is the same with our Heavenly Father. God gets no pleasure out of our pain. His joy comes from watching us grow. Therefore, He will establish boundaries that teach lessons so we can mature.
2026-10-08.application: See everything through the lens of coming from a God who loves us more than we can imagine.
2026-10-08.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for loving us with an everlasting love.

2026-10-09.title: Perspective is Everything
2026-10-09.verse: So teach us to consider our mortality, so that we might live wisely.
2026-10-09.observation: Today’s song has a passage that asks God to give us a clear view of how quick life truly is. He is asking for God to give him clear perspective. Perspective is everything. Things that happen to us are not good or bad. They just happen. It all depends on how we look at it. For example, if someone misses an appointment that causes them to not get hired for a job, you would see that as something bad. However, what if they missed that appointment because his wife went into labor and delivered their first child? That changes things. What if someone was pushed down by a stranger? That sounds like a bad thing. Now imagine they were pushed down by a stranger because the stranger was saving them from getting hit by a car. That changes things. Our perspective is usually limited to only a fraction of what is actually going on. By asking God to give us a better perspective, we are asking God to open our eyes to see more of what is truly going on so we can be thankful. If we could see what God was truly doing, we would never doubt His goodness.
2026-10-09.application: Ask God to open your eyes to see a glimpse of what He is doing today.
2026-10-09.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for working in ways we will never understand to do things we will never realize.

2026-10-10.title: Living in the Awareness of God’s Presence
2026-10-10.verse: As for you, the one who lives in the shelter of the Most High, and resides in the protective shadow of the Sovereign One— I say this about the Lord, my shelter and my stronghold, my God in whom I trust—
2026-10-10.observation: This entire song is priceless. The main thing we can do with this song is to read it again and rest in realizing the goodness of knowing God is in control. It does not always seem that way. The enemy would have us believe that God is distant and unconcerned. However, that could not be further from the truth. This reminds me of one time we took our girls on a trip. To celebrate the trip, their grandmother gave them some money to spend. After settling in at our hotel, we took the girls to a store so they could buy something with their money. After making her purchase, one of my girls said, “I love Mamaw so much. She takes such good care of us.” There was a part of me that was a little frustrated. My wife and I had planned this vacation, paid for this vacation, driven them to this location, paid for all their meals, ate where they wanted to eat, picked out a vacation that they would enjoy, and they were currently sitting in a hotel we had paid for so we could listen to them talk about how great their grandmother was! How many times do we do this to the Lord? Every breath we take is because of God’s grace, then we celebrate someone else more than Him. There is nothing wrong with celebrating others. I was so thankful my mother-in-law blessed my girls. The point is that, in all our celebration and enjoyment of life, we should remember to be thankful for the One who ultimately makes it all possible.
2026-10-10.application: Take a moment and thank the Lord for the most basic things.
2026-10-10.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for every breath we take.

2026-10-11.title: Growing Over Time
2026-10-11.verse: The godly grow like a palm tree; they grow high like a cedar in Lebanon. Planted in the Lord’s house, they grow in the courts of our God. They bear fruit even when they are old; they are filled with vitality and have many leaves. So they proclaim that the Lord, my Protector, is just and never unfair.
2026-10-11.observation: When it comes to a tree, it takes 30 years to see significant growth. When it comes to a person, we only notice growth if we only see people occasionally. We often do not notice something we are used to seeing. This is the same when it comes to our relationship with God. It’s possible that God is growing you in more ways than you realize. The problem is you are around you all the time. Our job is to stay planted in God’s Word and in fellowship with other believers. He is growing us more than we realize. Only when we look behind us can we see how far we have come.
2026-10-11.application: Take a moment and celebrate how far you have come with the Lord.
2026-10-11.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for bringing us such a long way.

2026-10-12.title: God Has Always Been
2026-10-12.verse: Your throne has been secure from ancient times; you have always been king.
2026-10-12.observation: Have you ever talked to someone much older than you? I love talking to older people for two main reasons. The first is that they have amazing stories. I talked to someone who lived during periods of life that we only read about in history books. For them, it seemed like the world was going to end, only to realize that things worked out. Their stories seem like we are from different worlds, even though it was not very long ago. The second reason is their firm belief that everything will work out as it should. Because they have been through various seasons of life, they realize that things have a way of working out in ways we cannot imagine. They are not surprised by much. Things can be new, but people and the principles of life are not. Someone once said, “The more things change, the more they actually stay the same.” Now, imagine God. God has always existed. God is eternal. There is nothing new to God. Since that is true, nothing we will experience today will surprise, frighten, or concern Him. He has it all in His hands and is not rattled by the troubles of our day. Time will come and go. We will come and go. God remains.
2026-10-12.application: Think about life from God’s perspective. Since He is leading, we have nothing to fear.
2026-10-12.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for patiently guiding us through every moment of our lives.

2026-10-13.title: God’s Justice Will Come
2026-10-13.verse: He will pay them back for their sin. He will destroy them because of their evil; the Lord our God will destroy them.
2026-10-13.observation: God is just. His justice does not always seem right because He does not always move according to our timetable. In our world, most crimes have a statute of limitations. This means that crimes can only be prosecuted for a certain time frame. Once that time frame passes, the ability to be punished has come to an end. This is not the case for God. We cannot outrun His justice. Because He is eternal, His justice is the same. This is why we need a Savior. There is never a time when our sin is forgotten due to lack of evidence or lack of prosecution. This is a great hope for those who have been hurt in this life. We can trust that the Lord will give justice to those who deserve it in due time. If not in this life, they will receive it in the life to come. So never wonder if God knows what He is doing or wonder why He does not do something in the way we would prefer. Trust that He is doing more than we realize and His justice is on the way.
2026-10-13.application: Trust God’s justice and live in peace.
2026-10-13.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always giving us everlasting justice.

2026-10-14.title: Kneel Before the King
2026-10-14.verse: Come, let us bow down and worship. Let us kneel before the Lord, our Creator. For he is our God; we are the people of his pasture, the sheep he owns. Today, if only you would obey him.
2026-10-14.observation: I once watched a documentary of a soldier who loved his commanding officer so much that he could not speak of him without becoming emotional. He had watched how his commander had put himself in harm’s way to inspire and lead his men. This soldier had watched how his commanding officer had done without so the wounded could receive extra care. The soldier also spoke of how his commanding officer had stood up for his soldiers when they were hurting and needed to go home. The commanding officer had treated his soldiers like his own children. The result was a soldier who was so thankful and so inspired by his commanding officer that it brought him to tears. This was the human relationship between two men who respected each other. How much more should we love our Heavenly Father and King for all He has done for us. He loved us when no one else did. He gave His only Son so we could have life. He fills our lives with His goodness every day. He is worthy of our worship and honor.
2026-10-14.application: Take a moment and realize how truly blessed we are to have such a great King.
2026-10-14.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being such a great King.

2026-10-16.title: Tell of God’s Greatness
2026-10-16.verse: Tell the nations about his splendor. Tell all the nations about his amazing deeds.
2026-10-16.observation: There are two types of advertisements. There are those of a salesman and those of a satisfied customer. Have you ever sat across the table from a friend who has decided to join a company and they are trying to sell you the product? It can be a tough environment. If not done properly, it can feel like a violation of the friendship. You came for a lunch with a friend, and you are being sold a product that you do not want. On the other hand, have you ever sat across from a friend talking about how much they have enjoyed something and it makes you want to try it? It’s a completely different situation. One makes you feel obligated and the other makes you feel a sense of longing to experience what they have found. When is the last time you talked about the goodness of God in a way that made other people long for that kind of encounter with the Lord? When is the last time you spoke of God as a “satisfied customer?” Give it a shot today and see what it does, not only for those you tell, but for your own soul.
2026-10-16.application: Take a moment in a conversation today to say something true about God that you find wonderful.
2026-10-16.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being easy to talk about.

2026-10-17.title: Don’t Make Friends With Evil
2026-10-17.verse: You who love the Lord, hate evil! He protects the lives of his faithful followers; he delivers them from the power of the wicked.
2026-10-17.observation: I recently heard someone say that the word “sin” has been so altered in its meaning that it no longer carries the weight of its penalty. When you think about it, many people will use the word “sin” for something they probably shouldn’t do but secretly enjoy. Sin becomes something that is an outdated taboo that is no longer bad. Because of this, it was proposed that we stop using the word “sin” and start using the word “evil.”  Evil still has the theme we are going for when we speak of how sin should make us feel. If we began to use those words interchangeably, the text today speaks directly to the idea of opposing all the things that God opposes. Evil can be the deeds of those who purposefully work against the purposes of God. God’s Word tells us to hate those things. That doesn’t mean we hate the people who do them. We hate the acts themselves. For example, we hate adultery. We do not hate the people who commit this “sin” or evil. They are broken and need forgiveness and healing. We hate the act of “sin” or evil out of our love for God.
2026-10-17.application: How could you get a better idea of why God’s Word tells us to stay away from sin if you replaced the word “sin” with evil?
2026-10-17.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for caring enough to tell us what will destroy us.

2026-10-18.title: Keep Your Thankfulness Fresh
2026-10-18.verse: A psalm. Sing to the Lord a new song, for he performs amazing deeds. His right hand and his mighty arm accomplish deliverance.
2026-10-18.observation: Have you ever heard of a rut? A rut is something that would happen to dirt roads. When cars would drive on a dirt road for a while, they would begin to develop ruts in the road because of the continual path. If someone did not smooth out the road, the ruts would become so deep, you couldn’t get out of them. Relationships can be like that. We can get into normal patterns and begin to go through the motions. Before long, the excitement is gone. Today’s passage says we should sing new songs to the Lord. Adding different ways to praise the Lord reminds us that God is always doing new things and we won’t always notice if we don’t get out of our normal routines. One way to do this is through a thankfulness journal. A challenge I like to do is to try and be thankful for something new every day. This is harder than it might seem after a while. It’s like a muscle you have to work at. However, once you start, it can become a game of constantly looking for new ways to be thankful.
2026-10-18.application: Start a thankfulness journal. Try to think of something new to be thankful for each day.
2026-10-18.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always doing something worth celebrating.

2026-10-19.title: Remember Who You Serve
2026-10-19.verse: The Lord reigns! The nations tremble. He sits enthroned above the cherubim; the earth shakes.
2026-10-19.observation: I watched a movie one time where there were enemies all around. It was difficult to know who was on what side of the war simply by looking at them. In order to tell, the movie characters simply asked them, “Whom do you serve?” The part I noticed in the movie was that no one ever hesitated, even if they realized that confessing whose’s side they were on was going to get them into trouble. They immediately announced whose’s side they were on. What would it look like in our lives to cultivate the attitude that we serve the Lord? We don’t have to think about it. We serve the King of kings who is King over all. No matter what it costs us and no matter what everyone else is doing. We serve the King. It would have a way of clarifying our next step in many encounters. It would have a way of reminding us how blessed we are. We serve the King and we are not ashamed.
2026-10-19.application: Carry yourself with the attitude that you serve the King today. How will that cause you to act and live differently?
2026-10-19.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being worth serving.

2026-10-20.title: Don’t Ignore the Lord
2026-10-20.verse: Acknowledge that the Lord is God. He made us and we belong to him, we are his people, the sheep of his pasture.
2026-10-20.observation: Have you ever had someone avoid you? I have. It’s an odd situation. You realize they see you. You see them making eye contact. However, they keep going as though they don’t. I’ve done this before. There was someone I was supposed to have a meeting with and I completely missed it. I was so ashamed. I was young at the time and thought the best way to avoid my mistake was to pretend it wasn’t there. Finally, that person walked right up to me and said, “Where were you?” I had no excuse. I offered my apology and it was received with no problem. They said it was completely fine. They had made that mistake, too, and still wanted to get together. It was way easier than I realized. Do we sometimes avoid God for one reason or another? I bet we would find that if we come to Him, He is not mad at us. He is longing to fellowship with us. He would forgive us of any sin and restore our fellowship. Whatever may be holding you back from spending time with the Lord, don’t let it stop you another second. Go straight to Him in prayer and watch what happens.
2026-10-20.application: Take time to pray to God today and tell Him if there is anything that causes you to sometimes avoid spending time with Him.
2026-10-20.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for Your grace.

2026-10-21.title: You Go First
2026-10-21.verse: A psalm of David. I will sing about loyalty and justice. To you, O Lord, I will sing praises. I will walkin the way of integrity. When will you come to me? I will conduct my business with integrity in the midst of my palace.
2026-10-21.observation: If leadership is influence, everyone is a leader. The question is, where are you leading people? We all have some influence if we have any ongoing interaction with people. Nowhere is this truer, or less noticed, than in our own homes. Often, men ask me how to lead their families. They will admit they have not always done so. Now they want to lead a family used to going their own way, with a father who isn't giving them any guidance. The answer is that there are many ways to lead your family. The one I find most helpful is leading by example. Vision is more caught than taught. If you want your family to read their Bible, the first thing they need to do is to see you reading your Bible. If you want your family to pray, they need to see you modeling an active prayer life. If you want your family to value church, you have to go and make it mandatory in your home. When we lead by example, it becomes easier to expect it from others. We also begin to understand the difficulties associated with what we are asking. Go first, and watch what happens over time.
2026-10-21.application: Develop and implement a plan to live your faith out loud in front of others. This is not to look good, but to be a living example.
2026-10-21.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being Someone worth living for.

2026-10-22.title: God Never Changes
2026-10-22.verse: But you remain; your years do not come to an end. The children of your servants will settle down here, and their descendants will live securely in your presence.
2026-10-22.observation: Things change. People change. Seasons change. Circumstances change. Everything changes except God. Part of the nature of God is that He is always the same and never changing. He is outside of time. Therefore, He does not age the way we do. The great comfort in this is that He is always faithful. He never has a bad day. Have you ever had a friend that you have not seen in a long time? Then, when you see them, you realize how much they have changed. I had a friend like that. During our time away, I married and had children. He had married, had children, but then divorced and left his family. Our lives had taken two different paths and we were now two very different people. The result is we were not going to be close friends anymore. The great thing about God is He does not do that. No matter how much we grow and change, He is always the same. He is always Good, King, Forgiving, and Able to do all things.
2026-10-22.application: Take a moment to celebrate the reality that God is always the same.
2026-10-22.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being always dependable and never changing.

2026-10-23.title: Rehearse the Goodness of God
2026-10-23.verse: By David. Praise the Lord, O my soul. With all that is within me, praise his holy name. Praise the Lord, O my soul. Do not forget all his kind deeds.
2026-10-23.observation: If I could, I would have this entire song as my Scripture for the day. This is one of my favorite songs. It reminds us of our need to consistently rehearse the goodness of God. Gratitude and thankfulness are like a muscle. If we do not use it, it begins to atrophy. However, if we do, it will become helpful in our lives. During my daily prayer time, I use the first few verses as a list to begin thankfulness. The songwriter says we should be thankful because we have been forgiven, we have been healed, we have been restored, we are being transformed, and our lives have been filled with good things. Even if we are going through difficulties, we still have more to be thankful for than we realize.
2026-10-23.application: Take a moment and find ten things you are thankful for.
2026-10-23.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being so good to us.

2026-10-24.title: God is the Author of Complex Creation
2026-10-24.verse: He established the earth on its foundations; it will never be moved.
2026-10-24.observation: Have you ever thought about the complexity of creation? Space is so vast it is difficult to get our minds around it. There are countless stars. Even our own solar system is almost beyond imagination. An astrophysicist named Hugh Ross says the planets are in just the right place to make life on Earth possible. The planet Jupiter is large enough to alter the trajectory of asteroids so they do not hit the Earth. Even the moon has its usefulness. Then, when we look closer at the Earth, we are amazed. The more powerful the microscopes, the more we discover. The Earth is far more complex than we can imagine. Life is literally overflowing every centimeter of our planet. All of this was creatively designed by our God. If He is this amazing and takes care of it all, do we really think He will lose us? Do we really think He will be sloppy in His care of us?
2026-10-24.application: When you see the complexity of Earth, remember that the same God is taking care of you.
2026-10-24.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for Your care and protection of us.

2026-10-25.title: God Tests Us For A Reason
2026-10-25.verse: until the time when his prediction came true. The Lord’s word proved him right.
2026-10-25.observation: When I was in school, I hated tests. I did not see a reason for tests. I especially hated tests at the end of the school year and saw them as nothing more than a cruel torture device for ruining the end of the year. Then I became a teacher. I had a completely different point of view. As a teacher, tests are vital. Tests are the only way I can gauge if my students are learning properly. I need to see if they are ready to move on or if we need to cover the material again. I realize that they will not understand level two if they have not sufficiently learned level one. It would do them more harm than good to elevate them if they are not ready. Therefore, testing is not to gauge their identity or value. It is to gauge their readiness to proceed. Many times, God will test us. God’s testing is not to destroy us or torture us. He is gauging if we are ready to proceed. It is also important to realize He already knows. This means the test is not for HIM to see if we are ready, but for us to see where we are.
2026-10-25.application: Embrace testing seasons of the Lord. They are there to make you better.
2026-10-25.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always working on us.

2026-10-26.title: The LORD Has Mercy On Us
2026-10-26.verse: He remembered his covenant with them and relented because of his great loyal love.
2026-10-26.observation: I remember when my girls were little, they would be bad all day long. They would not listen. They would not do their chores. They would argue with each other. It would be just a generally bad day. Then, at the end of the day, they would be perplexed to find out they wouldn’t receive the blessing of staying up later than their bedtime. They would be confused and say something like, “Dad, I was good.” They were referring to the last 30 minutes and did not want me to remember everything else. This makes me think of many celebrities and athletes. We see them boast of living for anyone other than God until it’s the big game or the big awards show. They say they are trusting in God’s goodness to deliver their intended result. We all have a tendency of doing this. This reminds us of how good God is to us. He remembers it all. He remembers the last 30 minutes, and remembers the last three years. He knows how deserving we are and are not of His mercy, yet He is still so good to us. He blesses us more than we deserve. He is so good to us.
2026-10-26.application: Think about how much God knows and still loves us all.
2026-10-26.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for Your constant mercy.

2026-10-27.title: Why Studying History Is So Important
2026-10-27.verse: When the godly see this, they rejoice, and every sinner shuts his mouth. Whoever is wise, let him take note of these things. Let them consider the Lord’s acts of loyal love.
2026-10-27.observation: When they are in school, many people do not always love studying history. I think this is because teachers become so fixated with dates and timelines, that they forget to tell the stories of the people. Times, technology, and seasons change, but people don’t. People have good times and bad times. They go through relationship issues, issues of meaning, and physical issues. When we remember this and look through history, we can see how God was with people in amazing ways. Think of the World Wars and how God was with people through those horrors. Think of the pandemics such as the Black Death and Spanish Flu. There are amazing stories of how God was with people and did so many wonderful things. We can find this in our own recent history. There is great joy in talking to an older person and asking about their history. They can tell amazing stories of God’s faithfulness. The more we study history, the more we find that God has always been faithful. He has been so predictably faithful, we can rest with assurance that the Lord will be faithful to us, too.
2026-10-27.application: Take a moment and think of your own recent history and how God has been faithful.
2026-10-27.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for showing Yourself faithful to every generation.

2026-10-28.title: The Foundation of Our Confidence
2026-10-28.verse: A song, a psalm of David. I am determined, O God. I will sing and praise you with my whole heart.
2026-10-28.observation: I heard someone say that confidence is not based on what you think you can do. It is based on receipts. It comes from knowing what you have done to bring you to that moment. For example, a student has confidence they will do well on a test because they know the hours they have put into studying. A speaker has confidence they will do well at a presentation because they know the hours they have spent in preparation. Confidence is accumulated from all that has come before. This is why the foundation of our confidence comes from the Lord. When we think of all the Lord has done and what He has revealed about Himself in His Word, we can be confident in who He is.
2026-10-28.application: Take a moment and think about how God has been faithful in your life and the lives of others. Nothing has changed. He is still good.
2026-10-28.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always being so good to us.

2026-10-29.title: The Lord Stands Beside the Lonely
2026-10-29.verse: I will thank the Lord profusely. In the middle of a crowd I will praise him, because he stands at the right hand of the needy to deliver him from those who threaten his life.
2026-10-29.observation: I was listening to an interview the other day about a guy who had recently lost his spouse. While he was dealing with grief and trying to figure out his next steps, someone asked how it was possible for him to handle being alone after so many years with his wife. He said he was never alone. In the darkest, saddest moments of his life the Lord has always been there. He said he realized that God was there and knew his wife more than anyone. Therefore, their shared relationship with God brought him comfort. He also knew that no one understood his pain better than the Lord. Therefore, his greatest companion was always there. What would it look like for us to realize we are never alone? The Lord is always with us. This does not mean that we should forsake friendships with others and become a hermit. It does mean there are likely to be seasons when we walk alone. We should always remember that we are never truly alone. The Lord is always standing beside us in our time of need.
2026-10-29.application: Take a moment and think about the fact the Lord is always close by.
2026-10-29.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always being close to us.

2026-10-31.title: The Lord Wins
2026-10-31.verse: A psalm of David. Here is the Lord’s proclamation to my lord: “Sit down at my right hand until I make your enemies your footstool.
2026-10-31.observation: I have heard atheists and Orthodox Jewish people say that Jesus was a failure. He claimed to be the king and that His Kingdom was not of this world but would prevail. During His life, according to the eyes of those who do not understand, He appears to have failed. His followers did not lead a revolt against Rome and His kingdom did not physically come to Earth. However, they do not see what God is doing. He did so much more than conquer a temporary kingdom for a short span of time. He conquered all things for all time. His Kingdom has long outlived the kingdoms of the day and He is not the king over a nation. He is the King of all kings. The Lord’s kingdom has come, but it is a kingdom of freedom and His reign is forever. Praise the Lord who is King forever.
2026-10-31.application: Take a moment and think about how great our God is and that we are part of His eternal kingdom.
2026-10-31.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being the conquering King.
